---
title: "Podcast"
subtitle: "One audio episode per lecture, for listening on the go"
engine: knitr
---

Each episode is a two-host conversation that walks through one lecture page: the main ideas, the running examples and what to take away. The scripts are written by AI from this site's own content, and the voices are synthetic (Kokoro text-to-speech, generated locally).

**On a phone:** start an episode and lock the screen; it keeps playing, and the lock screen shows play/pause and skip buttons. When an episode ends, the next one starts automatically. Your position in each episode is saved in this browser. For offline listening, use *Download mp3*.

The audio follows the lecture pages, so flags and exam relevance work the same way: listen for the overview, then use the page, the dashboard and exam practice to check yourself.
